title: Lipschitz rigidity for scalar curvature on singular manifolds in odd dimensions
summary: The main result of this article is a Llarull-type rigidity statement for scalar curvature on Riemannian spin manifolds with cone-like singularities in odd dimensions. The even dimensional analog was proven in an earlier work together with Simone Cecchini, Bernhard Hanke and Thomas Schick using index theory and the analysis of abstract cone operators, which applies to Dirac operators associated with generalized cone metrics.
